construction.name: common_axis_affine_then_full_axial_subdivision
construction.proof:
COMMON-AXIS AFFINE TRANSFER FOLLOWED BY COMPLETE AXIAL SUBDIVISION

Inherited controls are common_axis_prism_transfer/SOURCE_DECODER.txt and
review/constructive/AXIAL_SUBDIVISION_LEMMA.txt. Earlier public axial work
permits kH=h (and triangle/hexagon base subdivisions with uniform scaling).
It does not include this general axial-only common stretch kH/h while
leaving the canonical base unchanged. Those earlier identities remain
controls and their reviewed cases are included in comparison gates.

For a complete source of n regular prisms P_h with actual common axis
R_i e3=epsilon_i d, let k be an integer >=2 with kn<=100. For target height
H in {1,3/2,2,3}, put r=kH/h and A=I+(r-1)dd^T/(d.d). Apply A to every
complete source owner and center simultaneously. Its owner i is now
Ac_i+R_i P_(kH). A is invertible, so distinct full parents stay disjoint.

For each complete parent i introduce ALL slots j=0,...,k-1 with centers
  Ac_i + R_i ((j-(k-1)/2) H e3),
and the same actual frame R_i. Their closed axial intervals partition
[-kH/2,kH/2] and their common base is exactly the source/target canonical
polygon. They are complete height-H owners. The sign epsilon_i is not
ignored: offsets use the actual frame R_i. All sibling pairs have the
parent axial separator and all cross-parent pairs inherit one transformed
source separator A^{-T}u. No independent choice of pair translation occurs.

Compute the full transformed parent union's coordinate bounds from every
actual canonical source vertex under A. That is exactly the full child
union; no axial end cost is dropped. Recenter their common box once, then
apply one common center dilation rho>1 and outward cube restoration as in
the reviewed subdivision lemma. Native centers and unchanged quaternions
are checked on every actual wall and every sibling/cross-parent pair.

The inverse retains source path/hash/Git provenance and authors, n,k,h,H,
rational d,A,A^{-1}, common box midpoint and rho, and the complete ordered
(parent index i, slot j) map. Subtract the inherited axial slot offset and
invert A to recover the original parent center. No proper subset or count
is promoted in the present screen. The bounded k range follows kn<=100,
not a coordinate or angle search. The r=1 cases preserve earlier controls.

construction.name: whole_owner_return_after_auxiliary_patch_wall_release
construction.proof:
WHOLE-OWNER RETURN AFTER RELEASING AUXILIARY PATCH WALLS

The predecessor is a complete native packing obtained by gluing complete
published-source patches. Its module boxes prove compatibility, but those
box walls are not actual obstacles to the contained prisms. Retain every
whole owner, its source word and its proper frame. Remove only those
auxiliary box walls. For each pair choose an actual separating direction
from the two sets of prism face normals and cross products of prism edges.
The separating-axis theorem makes this list complete for convex polyhedra.
Every chosen direction must already separate the full predecessor pair.

With these directions fixed, solve one common linear system in all owner
translations and the single host scale: all actual prism vertices must
satisfy every host wall; each pair must satisfy its actual directed support
inequality. Whole source frames and all owner labels remain fixed. The
old packing is a feasible control. Further returns may choose different
already-realized separators from the preceding complete packing; record
every such predecessor and its all-pair directions. No metric angle is a
variable, and no independently optimized marginal state is combined.

Every retained finite witness embeds its complete parent native record and
SHA256, the source mark/word data inherited through that record, all fixed
frames, every realized contact step, and the new complete native packing.
Official exact-input host/all-pair verification is required. Numerical LP
success alone is not certification, and LP failure is not an obstruction.

construction.name: heterogeneous_complete_triangular_strip_rows_and_layers
construction.proof:
ALTERNATING WHOLE-TRIANGLE STRIP RETURN

The ordinary bounding cell loses half its area for an equilateral triangle.
Recover that area by a physical marked return before attempting a metric
realization. Put a=1/sqrt(3). The canonical unit-edge triangle has vertices
(a,0),(-a/2,1/2),(-a/2,-1/2). For index t>=0, use its identity frame when
t is even and its half-turn about z when t is odd. Put its center at
((t mod 2)*a/2,t/2,0). Consecutive triangles share a complete oblique edge;
their interiors lie on opposite sides of that edge. Nonconsecutive
triangles have disjoint y interiors except possible shared boundary.
Extruding each complete triangle through the same prism height L keeps
the same nonoverlap and all whole-owner identities.

A strip of m such prisms lies in the exact rectangle
[-a/2,a] by [-1/2,m/2], extruded through [-L/2,L/2]. Its dimensions are
sqrt(3)/2, (m+1)/2, L. Its midpoint is (a/4,(m-1)/4,0).
The additional half-unit of height is the retained pair of end costs;
it may not be discarded by an infinite-strip density argument.

Put complete strips in disjoint rectangular grid cells using these exact
dimensions. A grid A by B by C fits in the common cube of side
max(A*sqrt(3)/2,B*(m+1)/2,C*L), and contains A*B*C*m complete prisms.
Keep an explicitly indexed subset of N whole owners. This is a complete
finite return, not a marginal planar capacity statement.

The source is the classical equilateral triangular tiling and Cartesian
composition. PingYou Ltd supplies the finite strip/grid assemblies and
their certificates, without claiming the classical tiling as new. The
zero-gain ordinary-length branch and every tested finite strip length
remain useful controls. Native witnesses round the prescribed centers,
apply one common tiny outward dilation, retain the exact two half-turn
quaternions, and are checked on every actual host wall and owner pair.

Heterogeneous complete triangular-strip rows and layers

Use the alternating strip in TRIANGLE_STRIP_PROOF.txt. A strip of m whole triangular-prism owners has exact dimensions(sqrt(3)/2,(m+1)/2,L), including both end costs. Its centers before subtracting its bounding-box midpoint are((t mod2)*sqrt(3)/6,t/2,0), t=0,...,m-1. Its alternating frames are identity and the z half-turn. The midpoint is(sqrt(3)/12,(m-1)/4,0).

A proper signed cube symmetry acts on the ENTIRE strip, including its centers and alternating source frames. Take six fixed proper axis-permutation representatives. Their box dimensions are the corresponding permutations; no angle parameter is introduced. Unlike the earlier fixed-strip mixed-layer family, a row word may combine strips of different lengths as different whole modules, and consecutive layers may have different exact thicknesses.

For one exact layer thickness, choose a row type consisting of floor(S/module_width) complete identical strips across x. Its cost is the entire module row height, and its owner count is m times the strip count. Concatenating row types whose total height is at most S produces a physical layer; each row is centered across x, and all rows together are centered in y. Concatenating such physical layers whose full thicknesses sum to at most S gives a cube packing. The grammar's backpointer word decodes every strip, every t parity, every proper frame, and every box boundary. Disjoint interiors follow from full box separation between modules and the exact alternating-strip edge separation within each module.

All costs are(p+q*sqrt(3))/2 with nonnegative integer p,q, so the finite row and layer cost-state dynamic program applies directly. It retains whole strips and their complete boundary costs; a final named suffix of whole owners may be deleted while the full parent word is kept. Native and independent verification must reconstruct those actual owners and verify all host walls and pairs. The grammar is a construction family, not a completeness or optimality claim.

contribution.method:
This is an explicit replacement archive for 23 previously submitted cases, adding zero new distinct campaign cases. SUPERSESSIONS.json identifies the prior issue, archive, native hash and certified scale for each case. Ten replacements improve the pinned current nominal/reference bound; thirteen improve the complete native certificate without claiming a new ideal nominal value.

These complete constructions combine forced-phase prism-to-antiprism ring/slot inclusion, literal whole-owner prefixes, prism column and height/collar transfers, and retained whole-row returns. Every source has a full physical decoder with actual owner centers and frames. Certificate improvements arise from these physical operations; their narrower numerical scope is retained explicitly.

All active witnesses passed independent source, full geometry and current-public/private comparison review, followed by both official checks on the packaged native files. The archive preserves the complete source chain, original donor attribution, reviewed intermediate packings and explicit supersession identities. Some provenance audit scripts require the authenticated upstream Git snapshot or reviewed-source registry; the bundled official native validators are directly replayable.

Credit the new finite constructions exactly to PingYou Ltd. Original donors and their authors remain credited. These contributions may be published under the repository’s MIT license. No global optimum is claimed. Please treat these as stronger replacements, not as 23 additional distinct cases.
